notes: Bearer auth bypasses the CSRF checks entirely: no X-Requested-With header was sent and the request still succeeded. An Authorization header always wins over the cookie, so sending both still skips CSRF.
entry_id is autoincrement (1 here because this was the first entry).

contract change: new_achievements is now an array of metadata objects ({name, description, icon, rarity, achievement_type}) — the same shape POST /api/achievements/check returns — instead of achievement id strings; non-empty only when this write unlocked achievements (first_entry on the account's first entry).
